integrity: The complete length-13 square-free layer is independently generated by prefix and direct-product enumeration. All interior deletions are rescanned for every square period, two least-period implementations agree, and the symmetry quotient is recomputed from the labeled words.
scientific_limitations: The source already reports three symmetry classes at length 13. The new claim is the exact deletion-witness-radius split inside those classes, including the unique globally witnessed class. No assertion is made for longer lengths, and unpublished search output may contain the same refinement.
title: Global versus local deletion witnesses at the length-\(13\) irreducible square-free boundary
